name: status.openvibe.network
description: OpenVibe.Network checks every OpenVibe service about once a minute (its readiness endpoint and the release it runs) and publishes what it saw at openvibe.network/status. This address points there.
keywords: openvibe status, openvibe uptime, openvibe network status

relationships.linksLead: Network's own observations, stated as seen: a service that has not been checked recently shows as unknown, never as up.

links.label: Status page
links.note: Every service: up, degraded, down, not running or unknown, where it runs and when it was last checked.

links.label: Status API
links.note: The same rows as JSON, for scripts and monitors.

links.label: Releases
links.note: The release each service runs, and how far behind the shared libraries it is.
